newsitem.title: THAILAND: Hopewell says no delay in Bangkok project.
newsitem.headline: Hopewell says no delay in Bangkok project.

text.p: Gordon Wu, chairman of Hopewell Holdings Ltd, on Friday dismissed concerns among Thai government officials that his $3.2 billion rail and highway transit project in Bangkok faces serious construction delays.

"What delay. There is no delay. The project will be finished before the (1998) Asian Games. Don't listen to other people," Wu told Reuters after meeting Thai Transport and Communications Minister Suwat Liptapanlop.
